Contributors writing custom memory allocators for the physics simulation loop must observe these core constraints:

- Always use custom arena allocators for frame-temporary data to avoid heap fragmentation.
- Never retain raw pointers across frame boundaries; use generational handles or weak references instead.
- Verify that all allocated buffers are properly aligned according to SIMD instruction requirements (16-byte or 32-byte boundaries).
- Run AddressSanitizer during local test suites to catch potential buffer overflows early.

FROM golang:1.21-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -o /app/service ./cmd/server

FROM alpine:latest
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/service /app/service
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["/app/service"]
